cases.case_label: Rearranged L1 (~2 kb) in DMD from LRE2 source element
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~2 kb insertion containing a rearranged L1 element was found in the dystrophin gene of a muscular dystrophy patient; the paper focuses on identifying the active source element (LRE2) and does not describe the transcript effect in the abstract. Exon/intron location not given in abstract.
cases.quote: We have found a 2 kilobase insertion containing a rearranged L1 element in the dystrophin gene of a muscular dystrophy patient.
